name: Locale Translation Context
description: Adds a context (msgctxt) filter to core's interface-translation Translate and Export screens, plus context-aware Drush export.
project_description: This module adds context filtering capabilities to Drupal core's user interface translation (locale) pages. Gettext contexts (msgctxt) let developers disambiguate identical source strings that must be translated differently depending on meaning, but core exposes no way to see or filter by them. This module adds a Context filter to the Translate screen (admin/config/regional/translate), a Context select to the Export screen, and a context-aware Drush export command. Depends on the core locale module. No configuration form and no custom permissions; access is governed by core's 'translate interface' permission.
